Chapter 2

CSS 변수, Flexbox/Grid, 반응형 레이아웃

  • CSS 변수와 기본 레이아웃 연결
  • Grid auto-fit/minmax 카드 레이아웃
  • 768px/1024px 반응형 규칙
  • 다크 테마 토큰
  • 프로젝트 카드 HTML 요소 추가
  • 카드와 버튼의 hover 시각 피드백 보완
  • 전체 너비 네비게이션 여백 제거
  • 데스크톱 미디어 쿼리의 헤더 폭 제한 제거

Chapter 3 · IntersectionObserver threshold 0.2 섹션 등장 효과

에디터 js/main.js · javascript
1const navigation = document.querySelector("nav");
2const navigationLinks = document.querySelectorAll("nav a");
3const projectsSection = document.querySelector("#projects");
4
5console.log(navigation);
6console.log(navigationLinks.length);
7console.log(projectsSection);
8
9navigationLinks.forEach((link) => {
10 link.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
11 event.preventDefault();
12 link.classList.toggle("active");
13 console.log(`${link.textContent} 메뉴 active 상태: ${link.classList.contains("active")}`);
14 });
15});
16
17window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
18 console.log(`현재 스크롤 위치: ${window.scrollY}px`);
19});
20const isScrolled = window.scrollY >= 60;
21const passedHero = window.scrollY >= 300;
22
23navigation.classList.toggle("scrolled", isScrolled);
24document.body.classList.toggle("passed-hero", passedHero);
25
26console.log(`scrolled: ${isScrolled}, passedHero: ${passedHero}`);
27const sections = document.querySelectorAll("main section");
28
29const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
30 (entries) => {
31 entries.forEach((entry) => {
32 if (entry.isIntersecting) {
33 entry.target.classList.add("visible");
34 observer.unobserve(entry.target);
35 }
36 });
37 },
38 { threshold: 0.2 },
39);
40
41sections.forEach((section) => {
42 observer.observe(section);
43});

1const navigation = document.querySelector("nav");
2const header = document.querySelector("header");
3const navigationLinks = document.querySelectorAll("nav a");

5const menuToggle = document.querySelector("#menu-toggle");
6const topButton = document.querySelector("#top-button");
7const githubUsername = "Logan-kim-the-philosopher";
8const projectList = document.querySelector("#project-list");
9const projectsStatus = document.querySelector("#projects-status");
10const projectFilter = document.querySelector("#project-filter");
11const languageFilter = document.querySelector("#language-filter");
12let allRepositories = [];
13
14const typingText = document.querySelector("#typing-text");
15
16if (typingText) {
17 const text = typingText.dataset.text;
18 let index = 0;
19
20 typingText.textContent = "";
21
22 const typeNextCharacter = () => {
23 if (index >= text.length) return;
24
25 typingText.textContent += text[index];

28 };
29
30 typeNextCharacter();
31}
32
33console.log(navigation.tagName);

36
37navigationLinks.forEach((link) => {
38 link.addEventListener("click", (event) => {

40 link.classList.toggle("active");

42

44 target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
45 });
46});
47
48menuToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {

51});
52
53window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
54 const isScrolled = window.scrollY >= 60;

56
57 navigation.classList.toggle("scrolled", isScrolled);
58 document.body.classList.toggle("passed-hero", passedHero);
59
60 console.log(`scrolled: ${isScrolled}, passedHero: ${passedHero}`);
61});
62
63topButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
64 window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
65});
66
67const sections = document.querySelectorAll("main section");
68
69const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
70 (entries) => {
71 entries.forEach((entry) => {
72 if (entry.isIntersecting) {
73 entry.target.classList.add("visible");
74 observer.unobserve(entry.target);
75 }
76 });
77 },
78 { threshold: 0.2 },
79);
80
81sections.forEach((section) => {
82 observer.observe(section);
83});
84
85const themeToggle = document.querySelector("#theme-toggle");
86
87const systemTheme = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";
88const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || systemTheme;
89document.documentElement.dataset.theme = savedTheme;
90
91themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
92 const isDark = document.documentElement.dataset.theme === "dark";
93 const nextTheme = isDark ? "light" : "dark";
94
95 document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextTheme;
96 localStorage.setItem("theme", nextTheme);
97});
98
99const contactForm = document.querySelector("#contact form");
100const formStatus = document.querySelector("#form-status");
101
102contactForm.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
103 const formData = new FormData(contactForm);
104 const name = formData.get("name").trim();
105 const email = formData.get("email").trim();
106 const message = formData.get("message").trim();
107
108 if (!name || !email || !message) {
109 event.preventDefault();
110 formStatus.textContent = "모든 필드를 입력해주세요.";
111 return;
112 }
113
114 if (!email.includes("@")) {
115 event.preventDefault();
116 formStatus.textContent = "올바른 이메일을 입력해주세요.";
117 return;
118 }
119});
120
121const emailInput = document.querySelector("#email");
122
123emailInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
124 if (emailInput.value && !emailInput.value.includes("@")) {
125 formStatus.textContent = "이메일 형식을 확인해주세요.";
126 return;
127 }
128
129 formStatus.textContent = "";
130});
131
132async function fetchRepositories() {
133 const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/users/${githubUsername}/repos`;
134
135 try {
136 const response = await fetch(apiUrl);
137
138 if (!response.ok) {
139 throw new Error(`GitHub API 응답 오류: ${response.status}`);
140 }
141
142 const repositories = await response.json();
143 console.log("GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.", repositories.length);
144 return { status: "success", repositories };
145 } catch (error) {
146 console.error("GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다.", error);
147 return { status: "error", repositories: [], message: error.message };
148 }
149}
150
151function renderRepositories(result) {
152 const { status, repositories, message } = result;
153
154 if (status === "error") {
155 projectsStatus.textContent = `GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다. ${message}`;
156 projectList.innerHTML = '<button id="projects-retry" type="button">다시 시도</button>';
157 document.querySelector("#projects-retry").addEventListener("click", loadRepositories);
158 return;
159 }
160
161 if (!repositories.length) {
162 projectsStatus.textContent = "표시할 GitHub 저장소가 없습니다.";
163 projectList.innerHTML = "";
164 return;
165 }
166
167 projectsStatus.textContent = `${repositories.length}개의 GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.`;
168 projectList.innerHTML = repositories
169 .map((repository) => {
170 const description = repository.description || "설명이 등록되지 않은 저장소입니다.";
171
172 return `
173 <article>
174 <h3>${repository.name}</h3>
175 <p>${description}</p>
176 <a href="${repository.html_url}">저장소 보기</a>
177 </article>
178 `;
179 })
180 .join("");
181}
182
183function filterRepositories() {
184 const keyword = projectFilter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
185 const language = languageFilter.value;
186 const filteredRepositories = allRepositories.filter((repository) =>
187 repository.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) &&
188 (!language || repository.language === language),
189 );
190
191 renderRepositories({ status: "success", repositories: filteredRepositories });
192}
193
194projectFilter.addEventListener("input", filterRepositories);
195languageFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRepositories);
196
197async function loadRepositories() {
198 projectsStatus.textContent = "GitHub 저장소를 불러오는 중입니다.";
199 projectList.innerHTML = "";
200
201 const result = await fetchRepositories();
202
203 if (result.status === "success") {
204 allRepositories = result.repositories;
205 }
206
207 renderRepositories(result);
208}
209
210loadRepositories();

68const sections = document.querySelectorAll("main section");
69
70const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
71 (entries) => {
72 entries.forEach((entry) => {
73 if (entry.isIntersecting) {
74 entry.target.classList.add("visible");
75 observer.unobserve(entry.target);
76 }
77 });
78 },
79 { threshold: 0.2 },
80);
81
82sections.forEach((section) => {
83 observer.observe(section);
84});

86const themeToggle = document.querySelector("#theme-toggle");
87
88const systemTheme = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";
89const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || systemTheme;
90document.documentElement.dataset.theme = savedTheme;
91
92themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
93 const isDark = document.documentElement.dataset.theme === "dark";
94 const nextTheme = isDark ? "light" : "dark";
95
96 document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextTheme;
97 localStorage.setItem("theme", nextTheme);
98});
99
100const contactForm = document.querySelector("#contact form");
101const formStatus = document.querySelector("#form-status");
102
103contactForm.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
104 const formData = new FormData(contactForm);
105 const name = formData.get("name").trim();
106 const email = formData.get("email").trim();
107 const message = formData.get("message").trim();
108
109 if (!name || !email || !message) {
110 event.preventDefault();
111 formStatus.textContent = "모든 필드를 입력해주세요.";
112 return;
113 }
114
115 if (!email.includes("@")) {
116 event.preventDefault();
117 formStatus.textContent = "올바른 이메일을 입력해주세요.";
118 return;
119 }
120});
121
122const emailInput = document.querySelector("#email");
123
124emailInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
125 if (emailInput.value && !emailInput.value.includes("@")) {
126 formStatus.textContent = "이메일 형식을 확인해주세요.";
127 return;
128 }
129
130 formStatus.textContent = "";
131});
132
133async function fetchRepositories() {
134 const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/users/${githubUsername}/repos`;
135
136 try {
137 const response = await fetch(apiUrl);
138
139 if (!response.ok) {
140 throw new Error(`GitHub API 응답 오류: ${response.status}`);
141 }
142
143 const repositories = await response.json();
144 console.log("GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.", repositories.length);
145 return { status: "success", repositories };
146 } catch (error) {
147 console.error("GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다.", error);
148 return { status: "error", repositories: [], message: error.message };
149 }
150}
151
152function renderRepositories(result) {
153 const { status, repositories, message } = result;
154
155 if (status === "error") {
156 projectsStatus.textContent = `GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다. ${message}`;
157 projectList.innerHTML = '<button id="projects-retry" type="button">다시 시도</button>';
158 document.querySelector("#projects-retry").addEventListener("click", loadRepositories);
159 return;
160 }
161
162 if (!repositories.length) {
163 projectsStatus.textContent = "표시할 GitHub 저장소가 없습니다.";
164 projectList.innerHTML = "";
165 return;
166 }
167
168 projectsStatus.textContent = `${repositories.length}개의 GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.`;
169 projectList.innerHTML = repositories
170 .map((repository) => {
171 const description = repository.description || "설명이 등록되지 않은 저장소입니다.";
172
173 return `
174 <article>
175 <h3>${repository.name}</h3>
176 <p>${description}</p>
177 <a href="${repository.html_url}">저장소 보기</a>
178 </article>
179 `;
180 })
181 .join("");
182}
183
184function filterRepositories() {
185 const keyword = projectFilter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
186 const language = languageFilter.value;
187 const filteredRepositories = allRepositories.filter((repository) =>
188 repository.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) &&
189 (!language || repository.language === language),
190 );
191
192 renderRepositories({ status: "success", repositories: filteredRepositories });
193}
194
195projectFilter.addEventListener("input", filterRepositories);
196languageFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRepositories);
197
198async function loadRepositories() {
199 projectsStatus.textContent = "GitHub 저장소를 불러오는 중입니다.";
200 projectList.innerHTML = "";
201
202 const result = await fetchRepositories();
203
204 if (result.status === "success") {
205 allRepositories = result.repositories;
206 }
207
208 renderRepositories(result);
209}
210
211loadRepositories();

108const githubUsername = "octocat";
109
110async function fetchRepositories() {
111 const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/users/${githubUsername}/repos`;
112
113 try {
114 const response = await fetch(apiUrl);
115
116 if (!response.ok) {
117 throw new Error(`GitHub API 응답 오류: ${response.status}`);
118 }
119
120 const repositories = await response.json();
121 console.log("GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.", repositories.length);
122 return repositories;
123 } catch (error) {
124 console.error("GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다.", error);
125 return [];
126 }
127}
128
129fetchRepositories();

164 projectList.innerHTML = "";

130});
131
132async function fetchRepositories() {
133 const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/users/${githubUsername}/repos`;
134
135 try {
136 const response = await fetch(apiUrl);
137
138 if (!response.ok) {
139 throw new Error(`GitHub API 응답 오류: ${response.status}`);
140 }
141
142 const repositories = await response.json();
143 console.log("GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.", repositories.length);
144 return { status: "success", repositories };
145 } catch (error) {
146 console.error("GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다.", error);
147 return { status: "error", repositories: [], message: error.message };
148 }
149}
150
151function renderRepositories(result) {
152 const { status, repositories, message } = result;
153
154 if (status === "error") {
155 projectsStatus.textContent = `GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다. ${message}`;
156 projectList.innerHTML = '<button id="projects-retry" type="button">다시 시도</button>';
157 document.querySelector("#projects-retry").addEventListener("click", loadRepositories);
158 return;
159 }
160
161 if (!repositories.length) {
162 projectsStatus.textContent = "표시할 GitHub 저장소가 없습니다.";
163 projectList.innerHTML = "";
164 return;
165 }
166
167 projectsStatus.textContent = `${repositories.length}개의 GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.`;
168 projectList.innerHTML = repositories
169 .map((repository) => {
170 const description = repository.description || "설명이 등록되지 않은 저장소입니다.";
171
172 return `
173 <article>
174 <h3>${repository.name}</h3>
175 <p>${description}</p>
176 <a href="${repository.html_url}">저장소 보기</a>
177 </article>
178 `;
179 })
180 .join("");
181}
182
183function filterRepositories() {
184 const keyword = projectFilter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
185 const language = languageFilter.value;
186 const filteredRepositories = allRepositories.filter((repository) =>
187 repository.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) &&
188 (!language || repository.language === language),
189 );
190
191 renderRepositories({ status: "success", repositories: filteredRepositories });
192}
193
194projectFilter.addEventListener("input", filterRepositories);
195languageFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRepositories);
196
197async function loadRepositories() {
198 projectsStatus.textContent = "GitHub 저장소를 불러오는 중입니다.";
199 projectList.innerHTML = "";
200
201 const result = await fetchRepositories();
202
203 if (result.status === "success") {
204 allRepositories = result.repositories;
205 }
206
207 renderRepositories(result);
208}
209
210loadRepositories();

124 return;

130async function fetchRepositories() {
131 const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/users/${githubUsername}/repos`;
132
133 try {
134 const response = await fetch(apiUrl);
135
136 if (!response.ok) {
137 throw new Error(`GitHub API 응답 오류: ${response.status}`);
138 }
139
140 const repositories = await response.json();
141 console.log("GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.", repositories.length);
142 return { status: "success", repositories };
143 } catch (error) {
144 console.error("GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다.", error);
145 return { status: "error", repositories: [], message: error.message };
146 }
147}
148
149function renderRepositories(result) {
150 const { status, repositories, message } = result;
151
152 if (status === "error") {
153 projectsStatus.textContent = `GitHub 저장소를 불러오지 못했습니다. ${message}`;
154 projectList.innerHTML = '<button id="projects-retry" type="button">다시 시도</button>';
155 document.querySelector("#projects-retry").addEventListener("click", loadRepositories);
156 return;
157 }
158
159 if (!repositories.length) {
160 projectsStatus.textContent = "표시할 GitHub 저장소가 없습니다.";
161 projectList.innerHTML = "";
162 return;
163 }
164
165 projectsStatus.textContent = `${repositories.length}개의 GitHub 저장소를 불러왔습니다.`;
166 projectList.innerHTML = repositories
167 .map((repository) => {
168 const description = repository.description || "설명이 등록되지 않은 저장소입니다.";
169
170 return `
171 <article>
172 <h3>${repository.name}</h3>
173 <p>${description}</p>
174 <a href="${repository.html_url}">저장소 보기</a>
175 </article>
176 `;
177 })
178 .join("");
179}
180
181function filterRepositories() {
182 const keyword = projectFilter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
183 const language = languageFilter.value;
184 const filteredRepositories = allRepositories.filter((repository) =>
185 repository.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) &&
186 (!language || repository.language === language),
187 );
188
189 renderRepositories({ status: "success", repositories: filteredRepositories });
190}
191
192projectFilter.addEventListener("input", filterRepositories);
193languageFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRepositories);
194
195async function loadRepositories() {
196 projectsStatus.textContent = "GitHub 저장소를 불러오는 중입니다.";
197 projectList.innerHTML = "";
198
199 const result = await fetchRepositories();
200
201 if (result.status === "success") {
202 allRepositories = result.repositories;
203 }
204
205 renderRepositories(result);
206}
207
208loadRepositories();

171 const description = repository.description || "설명이 등록되지 않은 저장소입니다.";
172
173 return `
174 <article>
175 <h3>${repository.name}</h3>
176 <p>${description}</p>
177 <a href="${repository.html_url}">저장소 보기</a>
178 </article>
179 `;
180 })
181 .join("");
182}
183
184function filterRepositories() {
185 const keyword = projectFilter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
186 const language = languageFilter.value;
187 const filteredRepositories = allRepositories.filter((repository) =>
188 repository.name.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) &&
189 (!language || repository.language === language),
190 );
191
192 renderRepositories({ status: "success", repositories: filteredRepositories });
193}
194
195projectFilter.addEventListener("input", filterRepositories);
196languageFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRepositories);
197
198async function loadRepositories() {
199 projectsStatus.textContent = "GitHub 저장소를 불러오는 중입니다.";
200 projectList.innerHTML = "";
201
202 const result = await fetchRepositories();
203
204 if (result.status === "success") {
205 allRepositories = result.repositories;
206 }
207
208 renderRepositories(result);
209}
210
211loadRepositories();
